title: Tumbleweed Titanium Frames Are in Stock
content:
Tumbleweed has stocked its three titanium models: the Titanium Sunliner (above), Stargazer, and its Prospector Rohloff touring bike…

Tumbleweed Titanium Sunliner

This flat bar light tourer, that Spencer reviewed last year, combines the Prospector’s geometry and generous tire clearance with the Stargazer’s high-end tubeset—optimized for flat bars. It features a massive front triangle for extra framebag volume, and all the rack mounts you need for any adventure.

Frame: $3,100 USD

Build: Starting at $5,725

Specs: Identical to steel Sunliner (with UDH) signature build with Eagle 90. As always, complete builds are customizable.

AVAILABLE AS FRAME-ONLY OR FULL BIKE BUILD

Titanium Stargazer

Our versatile drop bar mountain touring bike with an upright, confidence-inspiring riding position. A direct descendant of the Prospector with a shorter reach for drop bars and a lighter overall package. At home on singletrack, gravel, or a fully loaded bikepacking trip. Read John’s Best in Class review of the steel version.

Frame: $3,100 USD

Build: Starting at $5,700

Specs: Identical to steel Stargazer (with UDH) signature build with SRAM Rival/Ratio and Eagle GX. As always, complete builds are customizable.

AVAILABLE AS FRAME-ONLY OR FULL BIKE BUILD

Titanium Prospector

Tumbleweed’s world-class expedition touring bike, designed around the 14-speed Rohloff internally geared drivetrain. Suspension-corrected, with an eccentric bottom bracket and tremendous mud clearance. Tested on rugged, fully loaded expeditions across the globe. Ryan Wilson has been touring on the steel version for a few years now.

Frame: $3,600 USD

Build: Starting at $6,925

Specs: Identical to the steel Prospector signature build. As always, complete builds are customizable.

AVAILABLE AS FRAME-ONLY OR FULL BIKE BUILD

Check out more at Tumbleweed.
